bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
set +o pipefail
lines="$(docker logs --since 30m deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -E 'INVITE_SELECTOR_(OPEN|EDIT)_FAILED|GAYBBS_ERROR|GAYBBS_BOT_READY' | tail -n 20 || true)"
set -o pipefail
{
 echo "INVITE_SELECTOR_RUNTIME_DIAGNOSTICS"
 if test -z "$lines";then echo "MATCHING_ERRORS=none";else printf '%s\n' "$lines" | sed -E 's/(bot_id=)[0-9]+/\1[redacted]/g';fi
 echo "USERBOT_ACTIVE=$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true)"
 echo "BOT_RUNNING=$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"
} | gh issue comment 7 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
